[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mali_near_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2020, classifying geographic areas in Mali by food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
